# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_module (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_rego_module" "example_zero_trust_cws_rego_module" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  rego_module_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `rego_module_id` (String) ID of the Rego module to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the Rego module to retrieve
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `package_path` (String) Dotted path derived from rego_source. Begins with lib. and is unique per account.
- `rego_source` (String) Library Rego source with a package beginning with "lib." Maximum 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `name` (String) Filter by Rego module name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `package_path` (String) Filter by package path (case-sensitive literal substring match)
